text: examples, note color codes printed black (like #FFFF00) others printed white (#0000FF). text colors chosen bg2fg() provide good contrast background, according methods defined WCAG 2.x (contrast ratio, relative luminance). can easily use bg2fg() displays. ’s example putting text within bars bar plot:
code: library(ggplot2)  data <- data.frame(x = LETTERS[1:3], y = c(40, 20, 30)) bg <- hcl.colors(3)  ggplot(data, aes(x, y)) +   geom_col(aes(fill = x)) +   geom_text(aes(label = y, color = x), vjust = 1.2) +   scale_fill_manual(values = bg) +   scale_color_manual(values = bg2fg(bg))

title: Print colored cells in the console — print_color
text: col vector, matrix, list vectors/matrices, containing R colors. Can character numeric. alpha (transparency) channel ignored. quote TRUE/FALSE whether print quotation marks around color strings. width Determines width color cell also whether color string text printed blcellock's foreground. 3 options: NULL (default), color string text printed, color cells size. size set based width longest color string. NA, color string text printed, color cell wide needed fit text. number >= 1, color string text printed, cell exactly floor(width) characters wide. gap Determines horizontal gap cells 2 options: NULL (default): width number (cells foreground text), gap. Otherwise (foreground text), gap 1 space. number >= 0, gap floor(gap) spaces. max Determines maximum number colors print. Either NULL (default, meaning use getOption("max.print")) number >= 0. number truncated (floor(max)) honored exactly printing vector approximately printing matrix.

title: Print colored cells in the console — print_color
text: Printing color console handled cli package, works best console supports 24-bit colors. print_color() determines many colors available using following mechanism: colorkit.num_colors options set, use . R running inside Positron, use 256^3 (~16.7 million). Otherwise use cli::num_ansi_colors(). visually check whether console supports 24-bit colors, run following code. result fairly smooth gradient within row, 24-bit colors. instead see color banding (wide, distinct steps colors within row) worse (e.g., nothing ), fewer colors available.   foreground text color cell determined bg2fg().
